ideas.title: Investigating Federal Overreach
ideas.description: An investigation into the use of federal power and the potential for abuse, including the cases of Frank Carone and the Minneapolis shooting.
questions: What are the implications of federal overreach for individuals and communities?
How can federal agencies be held accountable for their actions?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to reveal a larger pattern of federal overreach and abuse of power. By investigating the cases of Frank Carone and the Minneapolis shooting, we may be able to shed light on the need for greater transparency and accountability in federal agencies.

ideas.title: The Minneapolis Shooting: A Case Study
ideas.description: An in-depth examination of the Minneapolis shooting, including the events leading up to the shooting and the aftermath.
ideas.angle: Police brutality and use of force
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
How has the community responded to the shooting?
ideas.insight: I believe that this story has the potential to reveal important insights into the use of force by federal agents and the impact on communities. By examining the events leading up to the shooting and the aftermath, we may be able to identify patterns and trends that can inform policy and practice.
